 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 --message('test'); 
 synchronize;

 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','9','10','11') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NOT NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type,'X') = 'I' or NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) > 7 THEN
 show_error('1230');

procedure result_interpretation(p_unit_id in varchar2,

 p_result out varchar2) is
 
 nReaRes number := 0;
 nNonReaRes number := 0;
 pReaRes varchar2(10);
 pNonReaRes varchar2(10);
 nNTRes number := 0;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_local_date := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 --get the reactive counts 
 begin 
 select nvl(count(*), 0)
 into nReaRes
 from utrs
 where unit_id = p_unit_id 
 and test_id = p_test_id 
 and cancel_flag is null 
 --and extract_date is not null -- Commented by Kishore on 07/01/2013. SCR 19858
 and result_status_1 in (select code
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'REAC' 
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10));
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 --get the reactive result code for the unit
 if nReares >= 1 then
 begin
 select result_status_1
 into pReaRes
 from utrs
 where unit_id = p_unit_id 
 and test_id = p_test_id 
 and cancel_flag is null 
 --and extract_date is not null -- Commented by Kishore on 07/01/2013. SCR 19858 
 and result_status_1 in (select code
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'REAC' 
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10))
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when others then
 pReaRes := 'NT';
 end;
 end if;

 --get the non reactive counts
 begin
 select nvl(count(*), 0)
 into nNonReaRes
 from utrs
 where unit_id = p_unit_id 
 and test_id = p_test_id 
 and cancel_flag is null
 --and extract_date is not null -- Commented by Kishore on 07/01/2013. SCR 19858
 and result_status_1 in (select code
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'NREAC' 
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10));
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 if nNonReaRes >= 1 then
 begin
 select result_status_1
 into pNonReaRes
 from utrs
 where unit_id = p_unit_id 
 and test_id = p_test_id 
 and cancel_flag is null 
 --and extract_date is not null -- Commented by Kishore on 07/01/2013. SCR 19858
 and result_status_1 in (select code
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'NREAC' 
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10))
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when others then
 pNonReaRes := 'NT';
 end;
 end if;

 if nReaRes > nNonReaRes then
 p_result := pReares;
 elsif nReaRes < nNonReaRes then
 p_result := pNonReaRes;
 elsif nReaRes = nNonReaRes then
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 10/01/2013
 --check if there is a NT result present
 begin
 select nvl(count(distinct result_status_1), 0)
 into nNTRes
 from utrs
 where unit_id = p_unit_id 
 and test_id = p_test_id 
 and cancel_flag is null 
 and result_status_1 = 'NT';
 --and extract_date is not null; -- Commented by Kishore on 07/01/2013. SCR 19858
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 if nNTRes > 0 then
 p_result := pReares;
 else
 if nReaRes > 0 then
 p_result := pReares;
 else
 p_result := pNonReaRes;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- End of commented section */
 
 show_error('9327'); -- Added by Kishore on 10/01/2013
 check_package_failure; -- Added by Kishore on 10/01/2013
 end if;
end;

-- Added by Kishore on 11/22/2013. IM 9812
-- Change code here if any changes are made to the CALC_EXP_DATE procedure in the sbclib.pll library
FUNCTION CALC_EXP_DATE_LOCAL (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date, 
 p_product_code in varchar2,
 p_prod_type in varchar2)
RETURN DATE IS
 temp_v_chapter varchar2(4) := name_in('GLOBAL.chapter_id');
 temp_c_code_scheme VARCHAR2(1) := name_in('GLOBAL.code_scheme'); 
 temp_v_scan_date varchar2(9);
 temp_d_prev_exp_date date;
 temp_v_year_first_digit varchar2(1);
 temp_v_life_span_ind varchar2(1);
 temp_n_life_span number(4,0);
 temp_d_base_dats date;
 temp_d_cur_exp_date date;
 temp_d_max_dats date;
 temp_d_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_d_coll_date date := p_coll_date;
 temp_v_prod_type varchar2(5) := p_prod_type;
 temp_local_date date;
 temp_chap_sys_date date;
 temp_chap_proc_date date;
 temp_chap_bleed_time date;
 --orig_chap_id varchar2(4) := NULL; -- IM:8798 - 08/16/2012; -- Commented on 10/08/12; V27; IM:9170; not used anymore.
 temp_d_cur_exp_date_10yr date; -- Added on 10/08/2012; V27, IM:9170
 t_attrib_code master_codes.code%type;
 
 CURSOR c1 IS
 --SELECT life_span, life_span_ind, component_attributes.proc_date base_dats -- Commented by Kishore on 11/22/2013. IM 9812
 SELECT life_span, life_span_ind, component_attributes.attrib_code, component_attributes.proc_date base_dats -- Added by Kishore on 11/22/2013. IM 9812
 FROM valid_product_attributes, component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id 
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(temp_d_coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter
 AND component_attributes.product_code = p_product_code
 AND life_span_ind is not null 
 AND life_span is not null 
 AND valid_product_attributes.attrib_group 
 = component_attributes.attrib_group 
 AND valid_product_attributes.attrib_code 
 = component_attributes.attrib_code 
 --HCL valid_product_attributes.product_code
 AND valid_product_attributes.product_type 
 = ( SELECT product_type
 FROM valid_products WHERE 
 product_code = substr(component_attributes.product_code ,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = temp_c_code_scheme) 
 AND --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(temp_v_chapter,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y'
 AND not exists
 (SELECT 'x' FROM valid_exp_date_ovr
 WHERE attrib_code = component_attributes.attrib_code
 AND OVR_ATTRIB_CODE in 
 (SELECT attrib_code FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND product_code = p_product_code
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(temp_d_coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter)
 AND -- sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(temp_v_chapter,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y'
 );
BEGIN
 BEGIN 
 IF temp_d_coll_date IS NULL THEN
 SELECT max(coll_date) 
 INTO temp_d_coll_date 
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter;
 IF temp_d_coll_date IS NULL THEN
 return null;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 return null;
 END; 
 BEGIN 
 IF temp_v_prod_type IS NULL THEN
 SELECT product_type 
 INTO temp_v_prod_type 
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = substr(p_product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = 'I'
 AND --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(temp_v_chapter,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y';
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 return null;
 END; 
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 11/22/2013. IM 9812
 begin
 select code 
 into t_attrib_code
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'EXPAT'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(temp_v_chapter, sysdate) 
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1301');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- End of change
 
 --IF temp_v_prod_type not in ('RPL','RPFF') AND
 --temp_v_prod_type not like 'DU%' THEN
 --HCLC 
 --Expiry date will now be calculated for all products as it is no longer an enterable
 --in this screen.
 --
 -- check if there are attributes associated to the
 -- component that have expirations associated to them
 --
 -- prev_exp_date has the base value;
 -- cur_exp_date has the value which is the current
 -- value after the calculation; If prev_exp_date >
 -- cur_exp_date, then prev_exp_date made equal to
 -- temp_expiry_dats (simple logic for calculation of
 -- minima
 --
 
 
 copy('N','GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute');
 If is_timezone_enabled then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(temp_v_chapter, sysdate, temp_chap_sys_date);
 Else
 temp_chap_sys_date:=sysdate;
 End If;
 
 BEGIN
 
 temp_d_prev_exp_date := add_months(temp_chap_sys_date,12*100);
 
 --message('temp_d_prev_exp_date='||to_char(temp_d_prev_exp_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));
 
-- Commented below on 10/08/2012; V27; IM:9170
/*
 -- IM:8798 - 08/16/2012;
 BEGIN 
 SELECT chapter_id INTO orig_chap_id
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND contract_id = 'INTERNAL'; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 orig_chap_id := NULL;
 END;
 ----------- 
*/ 
 FOR c1_rec in c1
 LOOP 
 --message('Proce date is used here='||to_char(c1_rec.base_dats,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));pause;
 --message('Life Span: ' || c1_rec.life_span); pause;
 --message('Life Span Ind: ' || c1_rec.life_span_ind); pause;
 --message('Attrib Code: ' || c1_rec.attrib_code); pause;
 
 copy('Y','GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute');
 
 if c1_rec.attrib_code = t_attrib_code then -- Added by Kishore on 11/22/2013. IM 9812
 temp_chap_proc_date := c1_rec.base_dats; -- Added by Kishore on 11/22/2013. IM 9812
 else -- Added by Kishore on 11/22/2013. IM 9812
 -- Added By Edwin 03/20/12
 If is_timezone_enabled then 
 /* -- Commented below on 10/08/2012; V27; IM:9170
 If orig_chap_id is not null then -- Added on 08/16/2012; IM: 8798
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(orig_chap_id, c1_rec.base_dats, temp_chap_proc_date);
 Else
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(temp_v_chapter, c1_rec.base_dats, temp_chap_proc_date);
 End If; 
 */
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(temp_v_chapter, c1_rec.base_dats, temp_chap_proc_date);
 Else
 temp_chap_proc_date:=c1_rec.base_dats;
 End If;
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 11/22/2013. IM 9812 
 
 IF c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'D' THEN
 temp_d_cur_exp_date := trunc(temp_chap_proc_date)+(to_number(c1_rec.life_span)+1-(1/(24*60)));
 END IF;
 
 IF c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'Y' THEN
 temp_d_cur_exp_date :=add_months(trunc(temp_chap_proc_date), 12*c1_rec.life_span);
 temp_d_cur_exp_date := temp_d_cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 --message('inside the loop='||to_char(temp_d_cur_exp_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi')); 
 END IF;
 
 IF c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'H' THEN
 temp_d_cur_exp_date := temp_chap_proc_date +(c1_rec.life_span/24);
 END IF;
 
 IF temp_d_prev_exp_date > temp_d_cur_exp_date THEN --GMT Comparisons
 temp_d_prev_exp_date := temp_d_cur_exp_date;
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
 
 ---message('temp_d_prev_exp_date after first loop='||to_char(temp_d_prev_exp_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));
 -- modified on 05/25/2011; Ashok; 
 /*
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(temp_v_chapter, temp_d_prev_exp_date, temp_local_date);
 temp_d_prev_exp_date := temp_local_date;
 end if; 
 
 */
 
 --message('temp_d_prev_exp_date check 2='||to_char(temp_d_prev_exp_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi')); 
 END;
 --
 -- Check the expiry date/time based on the product
 --
 BEGIN
 SELECT life_span, life_span_ind
 INTO temp_n_life_span, temp_v_life_span_ind
 FROM valid_products 
 WHERE product_code = substr(p_product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = temp_c_code_scheme 
 AND --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(temp_v_chapter,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y';
 IF temp_v_life_span_ind = 'D' THEN
 temp_d_cur_exp_date := trunc(temp_d_coll_date) + (temp_n_life_span+1-(1/(24*60)));
 END IF;
 IF temp_v_life_span_ind = 'Y' THEN
 temp_d_cur_exp_date := add_months(trunc(temp_d_coll_date),12*temp_n_life_span);
 temp_d_cur_exp_date := temp_d_cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 temp_d_cur_exp_date_10yr := temp_d_cur_exp_date; -- Added on 10/08/2012; V27; IM:9170
 END IF;
 
 IF temp_v_life_span_ind = 'H' THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT bleed_start_time
 INTO temp_d_bleed_start_time
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id 
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(temp_d_coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 message('Error in selecting bleed time');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 -- Added By Edwin 03/20/12
 If is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(temp_v_chapter, temp_d_bleed_start_time, temp_chap_bleed_time);
 Else
 temp_chap_bleed_time:=temp_d_bleed_start_time;
 End if; 
 temp_d_cur_exp_date := temp_chap_bleed_time + (temp_n_life_span/24);
 
 --message('temp_d_cur_exp_date with bleed time='||to_char(temp_d_cur_exp_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));
 
 /*-- modified on 05/25/2011; Ashok; 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(temp_v_chapter, temp_d_cur_exp_date, temp_local_date);
 temp_d_cur_exp_date := temp_local_date;
 end if; 
 */
 
 END IF; 
 
 --message('temp_d_prev_exp_date check 3='||to_char(temp_d_prev_exp_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN value_error THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 WHEN others THEN
 message('Error in selecting from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 -- Below if condition - part added on 10/08/2012; V27; IM:9170. No need to compare dates if life span indicator is 'Y'.
 IF temp_v_life_span_ind = 'Y' THEN 
 temp_d_prev_exp_date := temp_d_cur_exp_date_10yr;
 ELSE
 IF temp_d_prev_exp_date > temp_d_cur_exp_date THEN -- Local Dt Comparisons
 temp_d_prev_exp_date := temp_d_cur_exp_date;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF temp_v_prod_type like 'PO%' THEN
 DECLARE 
 temp_pool_exp_date date;
 BEGIN 
 SELECT pool_expiry_dats INTO temp_pool_exp_date
 FROM pooled_components 
 WHERE pool_id = p_unit_id
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter; 
 IF temp_d_prev_exp_date > temp_pool_exp_date THEN
 temp_d_prev_exp_date := temp_pool_exp_date;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN 
 null;
 END;
 END IF;
 --message('temp_d_prev_exp_date -End sbclib='||to_char(temp_d_prev_exp_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));
 return temp_d_prev_exp_date;
RETURN NULL; EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 raise form_trigger_Failure;
END;
